description: Mask Korean personal data before you store, log or share it. Text mode finds and masks resident registration numbers (900101-1******), phone numbers (010-****-5678), emails (ab****@x.com) and 16-digit card numbers inside free text. Item mode masks given values by kind, including names (홍*동). Nothing is stored or logged.

items.description: Values with a known kind (up to 1000)

text.description: Free text to scan (up to 100,000 characters)

name: kr_mask_pii
title: Mask Korean personal data
